# ------------------------------------------------------------
# WGCNA and Functional Enrichment Analysis
#
# This script performs weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA)
# on VST-normalized RNA-seq data from rat neurons ± human astrocyte exposure.
#
# Workflow includes:
# - Quality control and MAD-based gene filtering
# - Soft-threshold power selection
# - Network construction (signed TOM)
# - Module detection and merging
# - Module–trait association analysis
# - Linear modeling of module eigengenes (limma)
# - Hub gene identification (kME)
# - GO (Biological Process) enrichment analysis
# - KEGG pathway enrichment analysis
#
# Input:
# - VST-normalized expression matrix
# - Sample metadata (neuron_group, run_date, FDU, prep)
#
# Output:
# - Module assignments
# - Module eigengene statistics
# - Hub gene tables
# - GO/KEGG enrichment results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
#| label: libraries
library(data.table)
library(DESeq2)
library(WGCNA)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(limma)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)


```

```{r}
)

stopifnot(is.character(pal_neuron_group))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
rat <- fread("/home/aleks/Desktop/Rat-Homo pipeline/ratNor7_gene_counts.txt")
metadata <- fread("/home/aleks/Desktop/Rat-Homo pipeline/neoteny_cocultures_metadata.csv")

```

```{r}
#| label: build-count-matrix-and-coldata
gene_ids <- rat$Geneid
count_mat <- as.matrix(rat[, -(1:6)])
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids

count_samples <- basename(colnames(count_mat))
count_samples <- sub("_ratNor7_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam$", "", count_samples)
colnames(count_mat) <- count_samples

metadata_sub <- metadata[!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id %in% count_samples]
metadata_sub <- metadata_sub[match(count_samples, metadata_sub$sample_id), ]
stopifnot(all(metadata_sub$sample_id == count_samples))

coldata <- as.data.frame(metadata_sub)
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample_id

```

```{r}
#| label: define-two-neuron-groups-by-name
cn <- colnames(count_mat)

is_rat_neurons_only <-
  grepl("RatNor_pn-Neurn", cn) &
  !grepl("cocultur", cn) &
  !grepl("HomSap|PanTro|MacMul", cn)

is_rat_neurons_human_astro <-
  grepl("HomSap_i-Astro", cn) &
  grepl("cocultur", cn)

keep_by_name <- is_rat_neurons_only | is_rat_neurons_human_astro
samples_by_name <- cn[keep_by_name]

group_sub <- ifelse(is_rat_neurons_only[keep_by_name],
                    "Rat_neurons_only",
                    "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro")
group_sub <- factor(group_sub,
                    levels = c("Rat_neurons_only", "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro"))

table(group_sub)

```

```{r}
#| label: subset-to-two-groups
samples_to_use <- intersect(rownames(coldata), samples_by_name)
samples_to_use <- colnames(count_mat)[colnames(count_mat) %in% samples_to_use]

count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, samples_to_use, drop = FALSE]
coldata_sub   <- coldata[samples_to_use, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub), rownames(coldata_sub)))

group_lookup <- data.frame(
  sample_id = samples_by_name,
  neuron_group = as.character(group_sub),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coldata_sub$neuron_group <- group_lookup$neuron_group[match(rownames(coldata_sub), group_lookup$sample_id)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(coldata_sub$neuron_group)))

coldata_sub$neuron_group <- factor(coldata_sub$neuron_group,
                                   levels = c("Rat_neurons_only", "Rat_neurons_plus_human_astro"))

table(coldata_sub$neuron_group)
```

```{r}
# диагностический блок batch

sid <- coldata_sub$sample_id

coldata_sub$FDU <- factor(
  ifelse(grepl("plus_FDU", sid), "plus",
  ifelse(grepl("no_FDU", sid), "no", NA))
)

coldata_sub$prep <- factor(
  ifelse(grepl("OPprep", sid), "OPprep",
  ifelse(grepl("IFprep", sid), "IFprep", NA))
)

coldata_sub$run_date <- sub("^RNA_Seq_([0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}).*$", "\\1", sid)
coldata_sub$run_date <- factor(coldata_sub$run_date)

table(coldata_sub$neuron_group, coldata_sub$FDU)
table(coldata_sub$neuron_group, coldata_sub$prep)
table(coldata_sub$neuron_group, coldata_sub$run_date)

```

```{r}
#| label: deseq2-vst-normalization
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(count_mat_sub),
  colData   = coldata_sub,
  design    = ~ 1
)

dds0 <- dds0[rowSums(counts(dds0)) > 0, ]
dds0 <- estimateSizeFactors(dds0)
vsd  <- vst(dds0, blind = TRUE)

expr <- assay(vsd)          # genes x samples
stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), rownames(coldata_sub)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(expr)))

datExpr0 <- t(expr)         # samples x genes (WGCNA format)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(datExpr0), rownames(coldata_sub)))

dim(datExpr0)

```

```{r}
#| label: qc-and-gene-filter
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::enableWGCNAThreads()

gsg0 <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr0, verbose = 3)
if (!gsg0$allOK) {
  datExpr0 <- datExpr0[gsg0$goodSamples, gsg0$goodGenes]
  coldata_sub <- coldata_sub[rownames(datExpr0), , drop = FALSE]
}

mad_all <- apply(datExpr0, 2, mad, na.rm = TRUE)

# stricter filter helps avoid 2 giant modules
thr <- quantile(mad_all, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE)  # top 50% by MAD
keep_genes <- mad_all > thr

datExpr0 <- datExpr0[, keep_genes, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(is.finite(datExpr0)))

dim(datExpr0)

```

```{r}
#| label: pick-soft-threshold-all
powers <- 1:20
sft_all <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr0, powerVector = powers, networkType = "signed", verbose = 5)

softPower <- sft_all$powerEstimate
if (is.na(softPower)) softPower <- 6

softPower

```

```{r}
net_all <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr0,
  power = softPower,
  networkType = "signed",
  TOMType = "signed",
  minModuleSize = 20,
  deepSplit = 4,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.40,
  numericLabels = FALSE,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3,
  maxBlockSize = 20000,
  corType = "pearson"
)


moduleColors_all <- net_all$colors
names(moduleColors_all) <- colnames(datExpr0)

MEs_all <- net_all$MEs
stopifnot(identical(rownames(MEs_all), rownames(datExpr0)))

sort(table(moduleColors_all), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
length(unique(moduleColors_all))

```

```{r}
#| label: build-me-table
ME_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(MEs_all),
  neuron_group = coldata_sub[rownames(MEs_all), "neuron_group"],
  MEs_all,
  row.names = rownames(MEs_all),
  check.names = FALSE
)

stopifnot(!any(is.na(ME_df$neuron_group)))
table(ME_df$neuron_group)

```

```{r}
#| label: test-fdu-effect-in-control

# берём только control
ctrl_idx <- coldata_sub$neuron_group == "Rat_neurons_only"

MEs_ctrl_only <- MEs_all[ctrl_idx, ]
meta_ctrl_only <- coldata_sub[ctrl_idx, ]



# убираем NA
keep <- !is.na(meta_ctrl_only$FDU)
MEs_ctrl_only <- MEs_ctrl_only[keep, ]
meta_ctrl_only <- meta_ctrl_only[keep, ]

# модель: ME ~ FDU
ME_mat <- t(as.matrix(MEs_ctrl_only))
design <- model.matrix(~ FDU, data = meta_ctrl_only)

fit <- lmFit(ME_mat, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

res_fdu <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf)
head(res_fdu)

#| label: sync-vsd-coldata

stopifnot(identical(rownames(coldata_sub), colnames(assay(vsd))))

colData(vsd)$neuron_group <- coldata_sub$neuron_group
colData(vsd)$run_date     <- coldata_sub$run_date
colData(vsd)$FDU          <- coldata_sub$FDU
colData(vsd)$prep         <- coldata_sub$prep

#| label: pca-two-plots

plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "run_date")
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "neuron_group")

table(coldata_sub$neuron_group, coldata_sub$run_date)



```

```{r}
#| label: align-samples-and-build-design-safely

# 1) ME matrix in limma-friendly orientation: modules x samples
ME_mat <- t(as.matrix(MEs_all))

# 2) Keep ONLY samples that exist in both ME_mat and coldata_sub
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(ME_mat), rownames(coldata_sub))

ME_mat <- ME_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
coldata_me <- coldata_sub[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# 3) Replace NA with "unknown" for covariates (so model.matrix won't drop rows)
for (v in c("FDU", "prep", "run_date")) {
  if (v %in% colnames(coldata_me)) {
    x <- as.character(coldata_me[[v]])
    x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "unknown"
    coldata_me[[v]] <- factor(x)
  }
}

# 4) Drop covariates that have <2 levels in this subset (otherwise contrasts error)
candidate_covars <- c("FDU", "prep", "run_date")
covars_present <- intersect(candidate_covars, colnames(coldata_me))
covars_present <- covars_present[sapply(covars_present, function(v) nlevels(droplevels(coldata_me[[v]])) >= 2)]

covars_present

# 5) Build formula
form <- as.formula(
  paste("~ neuron_group",
        if (length(covars_present) > 0) paste("+", paste(covars_present, collapse = " + ")) else "")
)

# IMPORTANT: na.action = na.pass so it never drops rows
design <- model.matrix(form, data = coldata_me, na.action = na.pass)

# 6) Final sanity: exact same sample order
stopifnot(identical(rownames(design), colnames(ME_mat)))
stopifnot(nrow(design) == ncol(ME_mat))

# print quick diagnostics
dim(design)
dim(ME_mat)

```

```{r}
#| label: limma-compare-modules

fit <- lmFit(ME_mat, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

coef_name <- grep("^neuron_group", colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]
coef_name

me_stats <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
me_stats$module <- rownames(me_stats)
me_stats <- me_stats[, c("module", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")]

head(me_stats, 20)

```

```{r}
#| label: compare-modules-with-linear-model-fixed

candidate_covars <- c("FDU", "prep", "run_date")
covars_present <- intersect(candidate_covars, colnames(coldata_me))

form <- as.formula(
  paste("~ neuron_group",
        if (length(covars_present) > 0) paste("+", paste(covars_present, collapse = " + ")) else "")
)

design <- model.matrix(form, data = coldata_me)

ME_mat <- t(as.matrix(MEs_all))  # modules x samples

# КРИТИЧНО: design rows = samples, ME_mat columns = samples
stopifnot(nrow(design) == ncol(ME_mat))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(design), colnames(ME_mat)))

fit <- lmFit(ME_mat, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

coef_name <- grep("^neuron_group", colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]

me_stats <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
me_stats$module <- rownames(me_stats)
me_stats <- me_stats[, c("module", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")]

head(me_stats, 20)

```

```{r}
#| label: qc-filter-function
# Minimal helper: QC + MAD filter for WGCNA matrices (samples x genes)
qc_filter <- function(datExpr, mad_quantile = 0.50, verbose = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(datExpr))
  if (verbose) message("qc_filter(): input dim = ", paste(dim(datExpr), collapse = " x "))

  # goodSamplesGenes QC
  gsg <- WGCNA::goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = if (verbose) 3 else 0)
  if (!gsg$allOK) {
    datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes, drop = FALSE]
    if (verbose) message("qc_filter(): after goodSamplesGenes dim = ", paste(dim(datExpr), collapse = " x "))
  }

  # MAD filter across genes
  mad_all <- apply(datExpr, 2, mad, na.rm = TRUE)
  thr <- quantile(mad_all, mad_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep <- mad_all > thr

  datExpr <- datExpr[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if (verbose) message("qc_filter(): after MAD filter dim = ", paste(dim(datExpr), collapse = " x "))

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(datExpr)))
  datExpr
}


```

```{r}
#| label: hub-genes-by-kME
stopifnot(all(genes_module %in% colnames(datExpr0_f)))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(datExpr0_f), rownames(MEs_all)))

kME_mat <- WGCNA::signedKME(
  datExpr0_f[, genes_module, drop = FALSE],
  MEs_all[, ME_name, drop = FALSE]
)

hub_tbl <- data.frame(
  gene_id  = rownames(kME_mat),
  kME      = kME_mat[, 1],
  ENSEMBL  = sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(kME_mat)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_map, by = "ENSEMBL") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(kME))

head(hub_tbl, 30)
```
